content.title: Duke’s Cameron and Cayden Boozer twins make first national ad appearance in State Farm spot

Privacy Policy Accept Deny Non-Essential Close Cookie Preferences MarketingDuke’s Boozer twins make first national ad appearance in State Farm spot03.12.2026 Duke basketball freshmen F Cameron Boozer and G Cayden Boozer are making their “first appearance in a national advertisement” in a spot for State Farm. Icon Sportswire via Getty Images Duke basketball freshmen F Cameron Boozer and G Cayden Boozer are making their “first appearance in a national advertisement” in a spot for State Farm, according to Tim Nudd of AD AGE. The twin brothers “appear with Jake From State Farm” in the 30-second spot from Highdive, which is “premiering on Selection Sunday and running throughout the NCAA men’s basketball tournament.” The ad titled “Will You Be There” is part of State Farm’s broader basketball marketing platform, “With the Assist.” The campaign will appear “across TV, digital, streaming and social during the tournament.” Highdive developed the creative, with Optimum Sports, STN Digital, Infinity Marketing Team, OMD and FleishmanHillard “contributing to other parts of the broader marketing effort.” The Boozer ad joins a lineup of athlete partnerships that has also included Fever G Caitlin Clark, Mavericks F Cooper Flagg and former NBAer Chris Paul (AD AGE, 3/11).PREVIOUSElizabeth Lindsey breaks down the process behind Wasserman’s rebrand to ‘The Team’NEXTMarketplace RoundupSponsored contentAdditional SectionsAwards & HonorsBettingCollegesDataEvents and Attractions Exec TransactionsFacilitiesFinanceFranchisesInternationalLabor and AgentsLeagues and Governing BodiesLegal and GovernanceMarketingMediaOlympicsOpinionPeople and Pop CultureSports and SocietyTechWomen's SportsPodcastsSBJ Morning Buzzcast: March 26, 2026March 26, 2026SBJ TVSBJ On Stage: CAA’s Howie NuchowOpens in new windowMarch 09, 2026Apple TV’s Taylor Twellman looks ahead to 2026 FIFA World CupOpens in new windowMarch 04, 2026WatchOpens in new windowUtah’s Mark Harlan on the evolution of college sportsOpens in new windowMarch 02, 2026WatchOpens in new window
